name: moss-hacker-starter
description: LiveKit voice agent (Python) + Next.js frontend starter with Moss document retrieval

scripts.setup: pnpm install:frontend && pnpm install:messaging && pnpm install:agent-py && pnpm env:copy
scripts.env:copy: test -f frontend/.env.local || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local; test -f agent-py/.env.local || cp agent-py/.env.example agent-py/.env.local; test -f messaging/.env || cp messaging/.env.example messaging/.env
scripts.dev: concurrently -n agent-py,frontend,imessage,uploader -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "pnpm dev:agent-py" "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:messaging" "pnpm dev:uploader"
scripts.format: pnpm --dir frontend format && uv --directory agent-py run ruff format .
